plan.title: Distinguish warm-cache, first-run and unsupported cold-cache measurements

criteria.description: Measurement helper preserves default warm-cache samples, labels first-run separately, validates sample counts and computes nearest-rank summaries from fixtures. Cold-cache requests fail closed without verified cache-reset support.
Document controlled cold-cache preparation, side effects and evidence requirements without treating new processes or files as cache resets; run a small real workload smoke for both supported labels.

limitations: No host-wide cache purge or tool installation. Actual cold-cache results and thirty-sample comparative performance conclusions belong to a later task; this helper refuses cold-cache until a verifiable reset backend exists. First-run means first status after receipt preparation, which already reads inputs.
